</div> <div id="sing-area" style="display:none;"> <h3>Now it's your turn!</h3> <p>Sing the song you just heard.</p> <button id="record-button">🎤 Start recording</button> <p id="record-status"></p> </div> <script> (function () { const song = document.getElementById("song"); const playButton = document.getElementById("play-song"); const songArea = document.getElementById("song-area"); const singArea = document.getElementById("sing-area"); const recordButton = document.getElementById("record-button"); const status = document.getElementById("record-status"); let mediaRecorder = null; let audioStream = null; let recordingCount = 0; let isRecording = false; // Play song playButton.addEventListener("click", function () { playButton.disabled = true; playButton.textContent = "♪ Playing..."; song.play().catch(function () { playButton.disabled = false; playButton.textContent = "▶ Play song"; status.textContent = "Unable to play the song."; }); }); // Show recording button after song song.addEventListener("ended", function () { songArea.style.display = "none"; singArea.style.display = "block"; }); // Recording button: start OR stop recordButton.addEventListener("click", async function () { // If already recording, STOP if (isRecording) { isRecording = false; recordButton.disabled = true; recordButton.textContent = "Please wait..."; if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state === "recording") { mediaRecorder.stop(); } return; } // Otherwise, START recording try { recordButton.disabled = true; status.textContent = "Requesting microphone..."; audioStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }); mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(audioStream); mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function (event) { // Audio is intentionally not analysed or saved. }; mediaRecorder.onstop = function () { // Release the microphone audioStream.getTracks().forEach(function (track) { track.stop(); }); audioStream = null; mediaRecorder = null; recordingCount++; if (recordingCount === 1) { status.textContent = "I can't hear you, try louder!"; recordButton.textContent = "🎤 Record again"; recordButton.disabled = false; } else { status.textContent = "Great job! Thank you for singing! 🎉"; recordButton.style.display = "none"; } }; mediaRecorder.start(); isRecording = true; recordButton.textContent = "⏹ Stop recording"; recordButton.disabled = false; status.textContent = "🎤 Recording..."; } catch (error) { isRecording = false; status.textContent = "Please allow microphone access to continue."; recordButton.textContent = "🎤 Start recording"; recordButton.disabled = false; } }); })(); </script>
